hints.text: The graph of $y = x + 2$ is a straight line. The region under it from $0$ to $6$ is a trapezoid.
The two parallel sides are the heights at $x = 0$ and $x = 6$: $2$ and $8$. The width is $6$.

explanation: A definite integral of a nonnegative function is the area under its graph.
Here the region is a trapezoid with parallel sides $f(0) = 2$ and $f(6) = 8$ and width $6$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Rectangle plus triangle
steps: Split the region: a rectangle $6$ wide and $2$ tall (area $12$) under a triangle with base $6$ and height $6$ (area $18$).
Any honest decomposition of the same region gives the same integral.
